reason: The weighty bills are all forms of state support for settlements: tax benefits for settlements along the eastern line and threatened settlements in Judea and Samaria (rows 1, 5, 7, 9), retroactive legalization of unauthorized settlements and outposts (rows 2, 4, 8, 15-17), connecting young settlements to electricity (row 3), and fast-tracking new settlements (row 6). The light opposite bills (rows 11, 13, 14: evacuating settlements, banning funding for unauthorized outposts) fit the same axis. The statement asks about reducing state support for settlements and names a price, so it matches the bills. Row 1 may also cover some communities inside Israel near the eastern border, but its substance is still state benefits for settlement, so it does not change the verdict.
